description.blurb: 2063 Bacchus is a near-Earth object of the Apollo group, approximately 1 kilometer in diameter.
description.more: Bacchus has an Earth minimum orbital intersection distance of 0.0677 AU (10,130,000 km), which corresponds to 26.4 lunar distances. On March 31st, 1996, it passed 0.0677525 AU (10,135,600 km) from Earth.
